verdict.rationale: Codex's docs and CLI/cloud features (running tasks, inspecting diffs, iterating with follow-ups) support a workflow for reproducing issues and verifying fixes, and some users report it effectively edits/tests code and resolves hard bugs quickly. However, other hands-on reports describe it 'struggling with almost anything,' being less agentic/context-aware than competitors, and being too slow or rate-limited to reliably support iterative debugging.
